videos.script: Every program in this course that failed ended the same way, with a block of lines starting with at. This lesson reads that block, and then stops it from being the last thing a program says. {{trace}} First the stack trace. Read from the top, it lists the methods that were running when something was thrown. The first one with your class name is where to look. {{catch}} Then try and catch, for the failures you expected. A loop over four values, two of them bad, survives both. {{checked}} Then the rule the compiler enforces. Some exceptions it ignores, and some it will not compile without. Reading a file is the standard case. {{finally}} Last, finally. The block that runs on every way out of a method, except the one where the whole program stops.
